summary: The 1983 Kinnikuman TV series is 137 broadcasts, each split into two ~11-minute segments (A/B) — our numbering is the BROADCAST numbering, independently confirmed by ja.wikipedia (全137話, 第106話 hiatus marker) and en.wikipedia (137 episodes). Episodes 1-119 adapt manga chapters 1-273 across seven arcs whose boundaries are corroborated by three independent sources (kinnikuman.fandom arc pages, ja.wikipedia arc headers, en.wikipedia ':Arcs:' season lines): Kaiju Extermination eps 1-6 = ch 1-25, 20th Chojin Olympics 7-18 = ch 28-51, American Tour 19-26 = ch 52-79 (but see below), 21st Chojin Olympics 27-47 = ch 90-121, Seven Devil Chojin 48-65 = ch 122-159, Golden Mask 66-86 = ch 160-208, Dream Chojin Tag 87-119 = ch 209-273. Three structural findings dominate: (1) eps 1-6 are heavily abridged AND scrambled — only ch 1-9, 16, 23, 25 of the 25-chapter Kaiju arc were animated, out of publication order, with two chapters later grafted into the Olympics run (ch 23 into ep 9A, ch 9 into ep 14A); (2) the anime EXCLUDES the American Tag Tournament (fandom's American Tour Arc page states this outright), and the 2nd Kaiju Extermination arc (ch 80-89) was routed to the 1984 TV Special and Movie 2 instead — so ch 68-89 are skipped between ep 26 and ep 27; (3) eps 120-137 (ザ・サイコー超人の挑戦編 / 地獄の極悪超人編) are anime-original with no manga counterpart and are ignored by the 1991 sequel, so they take no anchors. English-wiki density is front-loaded: Chapter pages exist only for ch 1-121 and carry an 'anime=' reverse-mapping field only for ch 1-51 (plus 101-103), and Episode pages stop existing after 108B — so eps 1-18 are dense/high-confidence while eps 19-118 are a checkpoint lattice built from Japanese chapter-title vs. ja.wikipedia episode-subtitle identity plus fandom arc-page chapter refs.

13A = ch 40 (悪魔のテリーマン ↔ テリーマン悪魔に変身), 13B = ch 41.

Chapter pages 46→16A, 47→16B (Chojin Olympic final, Kinnikuman vs Robin Mask).
Chapter pages 48→17A, 49→17B/18A (ch 49 straddles the ep 17/18 boundary).
18A continues ch 49; Chapter pages 50 and 51 both →18B. ch 51 closes the 20th Chojin Olympics arc — arc boundary confirmed by fandom, ja.wikipedia and en.wikipedia (all put the arc at eps 7-18).
Arc-span derivation: the American Tour arc opens at ch 52 (fandom arc page, chapters 52-79 = eps 19-26) and ep 20A is confirmed as ch 54, so ep 19 = ch 52-53 (故郷へ涙の錦 / おちぶれプリンス).
20A = ch 54 (7秒フォール) and 20B = ch 55 (ノーロープデスマッチ) — both verbatim title identity AND both stated on the fandom Chapter pages.
21B 殺人技・風林火山 = ch 56 風林火山対ビッグマウンテン (technique-name identity); 21A is the same match's opening. END deliberately not extended past 56.
25A ロビンマスク再登場 ↔ ch 64 仮面にかくされた悲しみ; 25B 決闘!アマゾン大渓谷 ↔ ch 65 グランド・キャニオンの空中決戦 — the anime relocates the Grand Canyon to an 'Amazon canyon' (see annotation).

28A 超人ふるい落とし ↔ ch 91 恐怖のふるいおとし; 28B ガソリンプールに挑戦 ↔ ch 92 カナヅチ・キン肉マンの大ピンチ (Kinnikuman can't swim).
29B 新幹線をケッとばせ ↔ ch 93 新幹線アタック; 29A is an anime-expanded gag segment (キン肉版・愛と青春) with no chapter title counterpart.
30A 最終予選・超人落としの谷 ↔ ch 94 富士の最終予選.
31A ゴール前の死闘 = ch 95 ゴール前の死闘 (verbatim). 31B 超人はパチンコ玉 could not be identified, so END is left at 95 rather than extended into ch 96.
Chapter 102 page states anime=Episode 36A, Chapter 103 page states anime=Episode 36B (Ramenman vs Benkiman). Single-wiki claim, but consistent with ep 37 = ch 104-105.
37B 土俵際にかけろ! = ch 105 土俵際にかけろ!! (verbatim); 37A スモウ超人リキシマン ↔ ch 104 蔵前決戦 (Kuramae = sumo arena).
Arc finale: 47A 奇跡を呼ぶ炎の魂 / 47B 史上初!V2 ↔ ch 119 タイム・リミット30分 / ch 120 勝利をわが手に. Ch 121 超人オリンピック総集編 is a recap chapter and is treated as unadapted (finales anchor to what they adapt).
Arc boundary: Seven Devil Chojin = ch 122-159 = eps 48-65 (three sources). 48A 出現!!七人の悪魔超人 ↔ ch 122 地獄からきた7人; 48B バラバラにされたミート ↔ ch 123 裂けたミート.
The Stecasse King match runs ch 123-126 and ends with the Kinniku Buster at ch 126 (arc-page chapter refs); eps 49B-50B cover it, and ep 51A opens the Black Hole match at ch 127.
51A 悪魔超人ブラックホール ↔ ch 127 (Black Hole match begins, per arc-page refs); 51B 戦慄の四次元レスリング ↔ ch 128 異次元超人.
54A アイドル超人対悪魔超人 / 54B 総攻撃!!悪魔超人 ↔ ch 131 (the Justice Chojin take over the fight) and ch 132 (the Devil Chojin pair off with opponents), both stated in the arc page's chapter refs.
55B 水中大決戦 = ch 135 水中大決戦 (verbatim, Robin vs Atlantis in the lake); 55A 恐怖のデビルトムボーイ ↔ ch 133 (Springman's Devil Tomboy kills Wolfman, per arc-page ref).
56B 恐怖!!ミイラパッケージ ↔ ch 136 (Mr Khamen mummifies Brocken Jr., per arc-page ref); the mystery-chojin reveal that follows is ch 137 in ep 57A.
59A 谷底に落ちたテリーマン ↔ ch 142, where Terryman finishes The Mountain with a Brain Buster and both fall from the ring (arc-page refs put the fall at ch 142 and the final lace-snap at ch 141).
Derived from the confirmed ep 62A = ch 150: ep 61 (ミートを救え / 謎の超人モンゴルマン) therefore closes at ch 149 敵か味方か!?, with ch 148 怪超人 opening the Denen Coliseum tag match per the arc page.
62A 地獄のシャワー = ch 150 地獄のシャワー (verbatim; Mongolman's rain cloud rusts Springman). 62B could not be pinned, so END is not extended into ch 151.
64B 出た!新(ネオ)キン肉バスター ↔ ch 155 新キン肉バスター!! (near-verbatim, the Neo Kinniku Buster's debut against Buffaloman).
Arc finale: Seven Devil Chojin ends at ch 159 ミート生還!! (fandom arc page + the Chapter 159 page 'Meat Revived!!'), matching 65B リングは男の友情.
Arc opening: 66A 伝説の黄金マスク ↔ ch 160 伝説のマスク!!, 66B 悪魔騎士の挑戦 ↔ ch 161 悪魔騎士出現!!; Golden Mask arc = ch 160-208 = eps 66-86 in all three sources.
67A 怪奇!ワニ地獄 ↔ ch 162 恐怖のワニ地獄; the Kinnikuman vs Sneagator match page gives the full match as ch 162-165 over eps 67-68.
68B スニゲーターの正体 = ch 165 スニゲーターの正体!! (verbatim), and the match page independently ends the Sneagator match at ch 165.
70B 正義超人全滅か?! = ch 168 正義超人全滅…!? (near-verbatim), and the arc page cites ch 168 for exactly that beat (the world map appears on Kinnikuman's body during the Planetman match).
74A 出た!ベルリンの赤い雨 ↔ ch 176 (the arc page cites ch 176 for Brocken's Red Rain of Berlin); 74B 地獄技アシュラバスター ↔ ch 178 さく裂!!阿修羅バスター.
Derived: 83A 悪魔将軍は軟体超人 = ch 200 軟体超人!!, so ep 82 (猛特訓!新必殺技 / 直撃!スカルクラッシュ) closes at ch 199 ジャスティス登場. Deliberately not extended past 199.

Arc opening: Dream Chojin Tag = ch 209-273 = eps 87-119 (all three sources); ch 209 失われたトロフィー is the second-Fuji/trophy chapter that 87A 夢のタッグトーナメント adapts. 87B not separately pinned, so END left at 209.
89A 恐るべし四次元のワナ ↔ ch 215 四次元のワナ!!; the arc page cites ch 214-215 for the Muscle Brothers vs 4D Killer Combo opening and the 4D Cross.
90A 驚異マッスルドッキング ↔ ch 216 (the arc page cites ch 216-217 for the Muscle Docking finish); 90B 戦慄!完璧超人 ↔ ch 217 謎の新勢力 (the Hell Missionaries appear).
93A はがされたマスク ↔ ch 224 仮面の秘密; 93B 逆襲!ロビンマスク ↔ ch 225 執念!!ロビンマスク (Hell Missionaries vs Robin/Warsman).
96B 血に飢えた悪魔コンビ ↔ ch 229 攻勢!!悪魔コンビ!!; 96A テリーマン甦る ↔ ch 228 運命のマリオネット.
99B キン肉マングレート復活 ↔ ch 233 2代目グレート誕生!! (Terryman becomes the second Kinnikuman Great).
103A 燃えあがる悪魔霊術 ↔ ch 241 魔界の掟; 103B アシュラマン泣く! ↔ ch 242 悪魔の涙!! (Ashuraman weeps).
Derived: 105A 残酷!鉄条網マッチ ↔ ch 245 金網の悪夢, so ep 104 (友情のコンビネーション / サンシャインの最後) closes at ch 244 覆面はぎ予告.
111B 決勝!ソードデスマッチ ↔ ch 256 恐怖のソード・デスマッチ!!; 111A 友情のロングホーン ↔ ch 255 奇跡の復活.
115A 復活!ザ・マシンガンズ = ch 261 復活!!マシンガンズ and 115B マスク・ジ・エンド = ch 263 マスク・ジ・エンド!! — both verbatim title identity.

continue_points.note: ep 2 ends at ch 5 but ep 1 already covered ch 7 — furthest first-time coverage is ch 7, so resume at 8 (ch 6 is picked up later in ep 3B).
ep 3 ends at ch 6; furthest first-time coverage across eps 1-3 is still ch 7.

annotations.note: The 25-chapter Kaiju Extermination arc is compressed into 12 segments and reordered: only ch 1-9, 16, 23 and 25 are animated (Chapter pages mark ch 10, 11, 13, 14, 15 as anime=None); ch 26-27 (Roots Island Arc) are never animated at all.
Publication order is scrambled: ep1=3,7 / ep2=5,4 / ep3=1,6 / ep4=16,8 — so ep 2's END (ch 5) sits behind ep 1's END (ch 7).
Ep 9A adapts ch 23 (巨人ナツコ) from the Kaiju arc, dropped into the middle of the 20th Chojin Olympics run; ep 9B resumes the arc at ch 33.
Ep 14A adapts ch 9 (恐怖のバスジャック) from the Kaiju arc, dropped into the Olympics run; ep 14B resumes at ch 42.

The manga's Grand Canyon aerial showdown with Robin Mask (ch 65-67) is relocated to an 'Amazon canyon' in the anime; ja.wikipedia records that the American arc's setting was changed at the manga authors' request.

22-chapter skip. The fandom American Tour Arc page states the anime EXCLUDED the American Tag Tournament (ch ~68-79); the 2nd Kaiju Extermination arc (ch 80-89) was routed to the 1984 TV Special instead (ch 82 to Movie 2). Neither is inside the 137-episode numbering, so ch 68-89 are never covered by the TV series.

The 21st Chojin Olympics is reordered: Warsman debuts in ep 32A whereas his manga debut is ch 107 (コンピューター超人), while the fandom Chapter pages map ch 101-103 to eps 35-36. Per-episode chapters between eps 32-35 and 38-46 could not be verified and are deliberately left unanchored.
Ch 121 (超人オリンピック総集編) is a recap chapter; treated as unadapted, so ep 47 anchors to ch 120 rather than the arc's last chapter number.

Broadcast hiatus between ep 106 (1985-08-18) and ep 107 (1985-10-06): ja.wikipedia states the anime had caught up to the manga, so the Dream Chojin Tag arc was split into Part 1 / Part 2 (the subtitle 'Part2・決戦!ピラミッドリング' is credited from ep 107).

type_corrections.note: Eps 120-124 (ザ・サイコー超人の挑戦編 / Ultimate Chojin) and 125-137 (地獄の極悪超人編 / Nefarious Chojin) are anime-original: they have no manga counterpart (the fandom manga arc list runs Dream Chojin Tag ch 209-273 straight into Survivor Match for the Kinniku Throne ch 274-387), and ja.wikipedia records that the staff were told to go original from this point and that the 1991 sequel resumes from the manga's post-tournament victory parade WITHOUT referencing these arcs — i.e. retconned/disposable rather than anime-only-canon. Stored type for eps 120-121 is currently anime-only-canon; eps 122-137 were outside the context file so their stored types are unknown. Sean's call.

structure.notes: NUMBERING: 137 broadcasts, each carrying two ~11-minute segments labelled A and B on kinnikuman.fandom (Episode 1A ... Episode 137B). Our stored episode numbers are BROADCAST numbers and align 1:1 with both ja.wikipedia (第1話-第137話) and en.wikipedia (137 episodes) — verified by air-date walk and by the stored manual anchor at ep 119 (last Dream-Tag broadcast) resolving to ch 273 (last Dream-Tag chapter). CHAPTER SPACE: fandom/ja chapter numbering, original Kinnikuman ch 1-387 (vol 1-36); volume boundaries taken from List_of_Kinnikuman_Chapters/Volumes_* (vol 1:1-13, 2:14-27, 3:28-41, 4:42-53, 5:54-67, 6:68-80, 7:81-94, 8:95-108, 9:109-121, 10:122-134, 11:135-146, 12:147-156, 13:157-168, 14:169-180, 15:181-192, 16:193-203, 17:204-214, 18:215-224, 19:225-235, 20:236-245, 21:246-254, 22:255-263, 23:264-273, 24:274-282). ARC LATTICE (chapters / our episodes), agreed by fandom arc pages, ja.wikipedia and en.wikipedia: Kaiju Extermination 1-25 / 1-6; Roots Island 26-27 / NOT ANIMATED; 20th Chojin Olympics 28-51 / 7-18; American Tour 52-79 / 19-26 (but only ch 52-67 actually animated); 2nd Kaiju Extermination 80-89 / TV Special + Movie 2 only; 21st Chojin Olympics 90-121 / 27-47; Seven Devil Chojin 122-159 / 48-65; Golden Mask 160-208 / 66-86; Dream Chojin Tag 209-273 / 87-119; Survivor Match for the Kinniku Throne 274-387 / adapted by the 1991 sequel 'Kinnikuman: Scramble for the Throne' (46 eps), not by this series — the fandom Chapter 387 page maps the manga's final chapter to Scramble for the Throne Episode 46. SOURCE DENSITY: the English wiki carries Chapter pages only for ch 1-121 (plus 159 and 387), with a reverse 'anime=' field populated for ch 1-51 and 101-103 only; Episode pages exist only through 108B and are mostly stubs; there are only ~20 Match pages and they carry chapter ranges but no episode field. Everything from ep 19 onward therefore rests on Japanese chapter-title vs ja.wikipedia episode-subtitle identity plus the arc pages' inline chapter references. DATA QUALITY IN STORED ROWS: 31 stored air dates disagree with ja.wikipedia — ep 38 should be 1983-12-25 (stored 1984-01-08), ep 87 has no stored date (should be 1985-04-06), and eps 90-119 are each exactly one week early (ep 90 duplicates ep 89's date and the whole tail shifts). Episode titles are absent for every row, and rows 47 and 86 carry the junk title '|airdate= |episodes='.
order_only: TV Special 'Kessen! Shichinin no Seigi Chojin vs Uchu Nobushi' (決戦!7人の正義超人vs宇宙野武士), aired 1984-04-06 between the ep-47 and ep-48 material: adapts the 2nd Kaiju Extermination arc (manga ch 80-89, Planet Rakka). Not part of the 137-episode numbering.
Movie 2 'Kinnikuman: Ubawareta Champion Belt' — the fandom Chapter 82 page maps manga ch 82 (初地球の出) to it.

flags_for_sean: NON-MONOTONE EARLY ANCHORS: eps 1-4 adapt manga chapters out of publication order, so ep 1 END = ch 7 while ep 2 END = ch 5 and ep 3 END = ch 6. The values are true (each backed by the fandom Episode page's own 'adapted from Chapter N' sentence plus verbatim Japanese title identity), and continue_points are supplied for eps 2-3, but if the position math requires monotonically non-decreasing end_chapter, the safe subset is to keep only ep 4 (END 16) and ep 6 (END 28) and drop eps 1-3.

EP 5 LEFT UNANCHORED: 5B is confirmed as ch 2 (Chapter 2 page states anime=Episode 5B; en.wikipedia's summary 'Kinnikuman tries to woo pop idol Nana Takahara' matches ch 2 少女歌手と怪獣). 5A (キン骨マンと骨肉の争い) most likely adapts ch 17-18 (プロレス大決戦 / キン骨マン, matching en.wikipedia's 'Kinkotsuman arrives and challenges Kinnikuman to a fight'), but no source states it, so no END was emitted rather than guessing between 17 and 18.

EP 47 END = 120 not 121: ch 121 is titled 超人オリンピック総集編 (Chojin Olympics omnibus/recap). I treat it as an unadapted recap chapter, which is why the arc's last anchor is ch 120 even though the arc page gives the arc as ch 90-121. If you prefer arc-boundary parity, ep 47 END would become 121 and the continue point 122.

CH 68-89 ARE NEVER COVERED by the TV series (American Tag Tournament excluded per the fandom American Tour Arc page; 2nd Kaiju Extermination routed to the 1984 TV Special / Movie 2). Continue after ep 26 is therefore ch 68 = END+1 by the C3 'skips never covered' regime, but a reader who continues at 68 will read ~22 chapters the anime never showed before rejoining at ch 90 in ep 27. Worth surfacing in the UI note rather than silently.

EPS 32-46 DELIBERATELY UNANCHORED (15-episode hole inside the 21st Chojin Olympics). The fandom Chapter 101 page claims anime='Episode 35A/35B', but ep 35's ja.wikipedia subtitles (秘技・万里の長城 / 米ソ超人激突) do not correspond to ch 101 (便器の底は無限大), and Warsman's anime debut at ep 32A precedes his manga debut chapter (107). The arc is reordered; I would rather leave the hole than fabricate a linear fill.

SOURCE-INTERNAL CONFLICT (minor): the fandom volume table places ch 80 in volume 6 while the Chapter 80 page's infobox says volume 7. I used the volume table throughout. No anchor in this deliverable ends on ch 80.

TYPE CALL FOR EPS 120-137 IS YOURS: they are unambiguously anime-original (2+ sources), but 'filler' vs 'anime-only-canon' is a ruling. My reading is filler — ja.wikipedia states the 1991 sequel resumes from the manga's post-tournament parade and does not reference these arcs (only occasional reuse of Gokuaku-arc footage in flashbacks). Stored type for 120-121 is anime-only-canon today.

STORED AIR DATES ARE DRIFTED for eps 90-119 (each one week early) and wrong for ep 38; ep 87 has none. Not anchor data, so no repairs entry was filed, but it is a cheap mechanical fix against ja.wikipedia's 各話リスト and it is what made the numbering audit non-trivial.
